summary: Master ESG data management and assurance readiness with practical controls, evidence packs, and reporting templates. Enrol to strengthen disclosure credibility.
lede: ESG data management training helps reporting, sustainability, audit, finance, and governance professionals organize and validate information for assurance review. Participants map data sources and lineage, build quality-control matrices and calculation workbooks, and outline evidence packs and approval workflows. The course covers reporting expectations in GRI, ISSB, and ISO 14064-1, along with governance concepts and AI-assisted disclosure review risks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already touch ESG reporting, sustainability data, audit support, or governance review and need stronger assurance readiness.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, spreadsheet software, and a working understanding of ESG reporting data. If available, bring a current disclosure draft, emissions workbook, or control checklist so you can apply the exercises to a realistic case from your own reporting environment.
